{{Top|leg}}
The '''Balding Sickness''' was an ancient persistent [[Drall/Legends|Drall]] disease. It afflicted some young Drall, causing them to lose their fur and sometimes even their lives. As some victim's of the disease resisted [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] treatment, the Drall searched for alternate solutions.

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] a [[Talus/Legends|Talusian]] herb was found that showed promise in curing this sickness. [[Champhra Biahin]], the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drall (planet)|Drall's]] ambassador to [[Talus/Legends|Talus]], was able to procure a sample of the rare [[Twin-Scented Natterbloom]] with the help of the local [[Dearic Garden Club]] and a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]].

==Behind the scenes==
This disease is mentioned during a quest for the [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|Non-Player Character]] [[Champhra Biahin]] in [[Sony]] Online Entertainment's [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']]. In this mission, Biahin asks the player to deliver a sample of the Twin-Scented Natterbloom to her and describes the sickness during the conversation with the player.
